title: Lord, Dismiss Us With Thy Blessing
author: John Fawcett (1740-1817); Godfrey Thring (1823-1903)
credit: John Fawcett, 1773; verse 3 alt. by Godfrey Thring, 1880.
firstLine: Lord, dismiss us with Thy blessing;
verses: Lord, dismiss us with Thy blessing;
Fill our hearts with joy and peace;
Let us each Thy love possessing,
O refresh us, O refresh us,
May the fruits of Thy salvation
In our hearts and lives abound.
To the truth may we be found.
So that when Thy love shall call us,
Fear of death shall not appall us,
May we ever, may we ever,
Reign with Thee in endless day.
